questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.topic: The logic of a move south
questions.learningObjective: Identify why a court moved south

stimulus.body: A court announces a move south after losing the north. It cites safety and resources. It does not mention the loss of the northern heartland or the cost of abandoning it.

questions.stem: An architect's brief asks how to read this move-south announcement

options.text: As proof that the north was never important
As a strategic retreat that omits the cost of losing the north
As proof that the move was effortless
As a weather report

questions.explanation: The move was a strategic retreat that omits the cost of losing the north. The north's importance and the difficulty are not negated by the announcement.
questions.hint: What a court omits when retreating.
